Package backend

Class Program

java.lang.Object
backend.Program
public class Program extends Object
Stores the parsed program state for a single sprite.

A program contains the sprite's top-level scripts, custom functions, variable values, and the set of variables whose monitors should be visible in the UI.

  • Constructor Details

    • Program

      public Program(String name)
      Creates an empty program for a sprite.
      Parameters:
      name - the sprite name associated with this program

    • Program

      public Program(Program other)
      Creates a shallow copy of another program. Scripts, functions, and variable values are copied into new collection instances. Visible variable monitors are intentionally not copied, since that UI state belongs only to the source sprite.
      Parameters:
      other - the program to copy
